description: On a runner with Docker: show works before any list exists; an ignore pattern keeps CI-style containers off the list; accept-current writes the containers present as Compose and name keys, leaving out ignored and --rm containers; add resolves a bare name and accepts explicit keys; remove takes them off; the previous file is kept as .prev; show reports a stopped and a missing expected container. Bad input is refused with exit 2 before anything is written. Confirm reviewed records the review with a note, refuses when no list exists, and Show reports the review state and stopped containers the list does not protect. A container whose Compose project label carries a forged row is shown as UNREADABLE by name and short id, left off by Accept current and refused by Add; the label never reaches the output or the list. When docker ps fails but docker info answers (a shim on PATH), Accept current and Add by bare name exit 3 and the list is unchanged, and Show says there is no comparison without changing the exit code. Accept current with no containers will not empty a non-empty list.

steps.label: Four containers: plain, Compose, CI-style, --rm
steps.run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/bin; cp /bin/sleep $d/bin/; for l in $(ldd /bin/sleep | grep -oE '/[^ ]+'); do mkdir -p $d$(dirname $l); cp $l $d$l; done; tar -C $d -c . | docker import - tc-test-sleep:1; docker run -d --name tc-a tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --name tcshop-web-1 --label com.docker.compose.project=tcshop --label com.docker.compose.service=web tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --name tc-runner-x tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker run -d --rm --name tc-temp tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.run: docker stop -t 1 tc-a && docker create --name tc-old tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 1 && docker ps -a --filter name=tc- --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'

Remove the ignore pattern

Put the list back
Hostile label: a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row
steps.run: set -e; INJ=$'x\nstopped-old\t/zz\t\t\t\tfalse\tfalse\tno\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t'; docker run -d --name innocent --label "com.docker.compose.project=$INJ" tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Hostile label: Show names it UNREADABLE, never the label
Hostile label: Accept current leaves it off and says so
outputContains: Left off the list - Compose labels are not plain names

steps.label: Hostile label: nothing from the label reached the list
Hostile label: Add by its bare name is refused, exit 3
outputContains: Compose labels that are not plain names

steps.label: Failing Docker: record the list, then put a docker shim that fails docker ps on PATH
steps.run: sha256sum /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers > /tmp/tc-ec.sha; real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker || exit 1; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: Docker answers everything except docker ps' '[ "$1" = ps ] && { echo "Error response from daemon: tc-test simulated failure" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; docker ps; echo "docker ps exit $?"; docker info --format 'docker info still answers: {{.ServerVersion}}'

steps.label: Failing Docker: Accept current exits 3
outputContains: Docker did not return its container list; nothing was changed

steps.label: Failing Docker: Add with a bare name exits 3 instead of guessing name:
outputContains: cannot be matched to its container

steps.label: Failing Docker: Show prints the lists and says there is no comparison
outputContains: Docker did not return its container list, so there is no comparison

steps.label: Failing Docker: an action that needs no container list still exits 0; its Show says there is no comparison
Failing Docker: the list is byte-for-byte unchanged; remove the shim
steps.run: sha256sum -c /tmp/tc-ec.sha; rm -f /usr/local/sbin/docker && docker ps >/dev/null && echo 'docker ps answers again'

steps.label: Empty guard: remove every container, keeping the list
steps.run: docker ps -aq | xargs -r docker rm -f >/dev/null; docker ps -aq | wc -l; sha256sum /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers > /tmp/tc-ec.sha; grep -c '^name:\|^compose:' /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers
